description_en: Queries the providers supported by the built-in model catalog of AgentCore and their default service configurations
description_zh: 查询 AgentCore 内置模型目录支持的供应商及其默认服务配置
name: ListPredefinedModelProviders

schema.description_en: The model text response returned when model debugging is successful. It is empty when debugging fails
schema.description_zh: 模型调试成功时返回的模型文本响应；调试失败时为空

code.description_en: The business status code. The value is SUCCESS if the request is successful
code.description_zh: 业务状态码。成功时为 SUCCESS

data.description_en: The list of predefined model providers
data.description_zh: 预定义模型供应商列表

items.description_en: The business value of this field

defaultEndpoint.description_en: The default model service endpoint of the provider
defaultEndpoint.description_zh: 供应商的默认模型服务地址

defaultProtocol.description_en: The default model invocation protocol of the provider
defaultProtocol.description_zh: 供应商的默认模型调用协议

displayName.description_en: The display name of the model provider
displayName.description_zh: 模型供应商的展示名称

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value is 200 if the request is successful

message.description_en: The message about the request processing result

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
